BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

4. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

5. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.

7. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

   B. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
